The method specifies substrate feed ratios, solvent composition, water activity control, temperature range, and flow rate parameters that together yield volumetric productivity above 4 g/L·h with enzyme operational lifetime exceeding 20 days. A downstream module for solvent removal and aqueous dispersion of the product is also claimed.

patents.title: Postupak kontinualne enzimske sinteze kratkolančanih estara aroma uz simultano uklanjanje vode pervaporacijom
patents.abstract: Patent opisuje integrisani postupak za kontinualnu proizvodnju estara aroma (etil-acetat, butil-acetat, izoamil-acetat i srodni C2–C6 estri) reakcijom odgovarajuće karboksilne kiseline i alkohola u prisustvu imobilisane lipaze Candida antarctica B, uz simultano odvođenje vode nastalog u reakciji kroz polimernu pervaporacionu membranu. Patentom je zaštićen specifičan raspored reaktorskog suda, membranske jedinice i povratnog voda za reciklažu neizreagovalih supstrata, koji omogućava ravnotežni prinos iznad 95% bez upotrebe organskih rastvarača i pri specifičnoj potrošnji energije ispod 5 MJ/kg produkta.

patents.title: Transrectal near-infrared spectroscopy probe assembly for postoperative anastomotic perfusion monitoring
patents.abstract: A probe assembly for continuous transrectal near-infrared spectroscopy monitoring of colorectal anastomotic tissue oxygen saturation in the immediate postoperative period. The device comprises a flexible silicone shaft of 12 mm outer diameter carrying two NIRS emitter–detector pairs at a fixed spacing of 25 mm, a retention balloon inflatable to 15 mL, and a shielded cable for connection to a bedside NIRS processing unit. The assembly is designed for single-patient use, insertion under direct endoscopic guidance, and retention for up to 72 hours. The invention is co-owned by the University of Novi Sad and the Faculty of Technical Sciences.

patents.title: Instrumented barbell collar for bilateral lateral force differential measurement
patents.abstract: A barbell collar incorporating an array of strain gauge bridges embedded in a machined aluminium body to measure transverse and axial forces transmitted from the barbell shaft to the collar in real time. The device includes wireless data transmission at up to 200 Hz and onboard analogue-to-digital conversion. Intended applications include monitoring bilateral loading asymmetry during Olympic-style weightlifting training without requiring fixed laboratory force platforms. The patent covers the collar geometry, gauge placement configuration, and calibration procedure.

patents.title: Flexible piezoelectric sensor patch with integrated charge amplifier for low-amplitude vibration measurement
patents.abstract: The invention relates to a flexible sensor patch comprising a PVDF-TrFE active layer between screen-printed silver electrodes, encapsulated in a polyurethane laminate, with a miniaturised charge amplifier circuit bonded directly to the patch surface using anisotropic conductive film. The patch can be adhesively bonded to curved or planar surfaces and operates in the 5–200 Hz frequency range at acceleration amplitudes below 0.5 g. The design eliminates the need for separate cabling between the sensing element and signal conditioning circuitry, reducing susceptibility to triboelectric noise. Application fields include structural health monitoring of agricultural storage structures, drone landing gear, and wearable motion sensing.

patents.title: Method for aerosol-jet printing of enzyme-containing bioink layers on flexible electrode substrates with controlled humidity chamber
patents.abstract: The invention relates to a method and apparatus for aerosol-jet deposition of enzyme-containing inks on flexible printed electrode substrates. A humidity-controlled enclosure (60–85% RH) surrounding the deposition zone prevents rapid desiccation of the aqueous enzyme carrier during flight and impact, preserving enzymatic activity. The method is applicable to oxidase and dehydrogenase enzymes immobilised in a poly(vinyl alcohol) matrix. Printed enzyme layers produced by the method retain more than 80% of reference activity measured by solution-phase assay, compared to 40–55% retention without humidity control. The patent covers the process parameters, enclosure design, and carrier ink composition ranges.

patents.title: Method for Covalent Immobilisation of Molecularly Imprinted Polymer Films on Silicon Dioxide Quartz Crystal Microbalance Surfaces via Methacryloxy Silane Coupling Agents and Application Thereof to Detection of Small Organic Molecules in Aqueous Matrices
patents.abstract: The patent covers a multi-step surface functionalisation procedure for silicon dioxide quartz crystal microbalance resonators comprising: controlled vapour-phase deposition of (3-methacryloxypropyl)trimethoxysilane at defined humidity and temperature; UV-initiated co-polymerisation of methacrylic acid and ethylene glycol dimethacrylate in the presence of a target template molecule; and a defined sequential solvent removal protocol. The procedure results in covalently anchored molecularly imprinted polymer films of 15–30 nm thickness with a sensor-to-sensor reproducibility of less than 10% CV of sensitivity slopes across a batch of at least six resonators. Claims cover the fabrication method, the resulting coated resonator device, and its use in quantitative detection of pesticides, pharmaceuticals, and hormones in drinking water and wastewater matrices.

patents.title: Method for Selective Passivation of Grain Boundary Surface Sites in Polycrystalline Metal-Oxide Sensor Films Using Low-Dose Ion Implantation
patents.abstract: A method for reducing water vapour cross-sensitivity in polycrystalline metal-oxide chemiresistive sensor films by implanting fluorine or chlorine ions at doses of 10¹³–10¹⁵ cm⁻² into the grain boundary regions of the film, followed by thermal annealing at 250–350 °C to recover crystal order while retaining halide species at grain boundary sites. The method selectively passivates surface hydroxyl groups responsible for water adsorption without requiring deposition of a separate physical barrier layer, thereby preserving analyte access kinetics. Applicable to SnO₂, ZnO, and In₂O₃ thin-film platforms on silicon or ceramic substrates.

patents.title: Method and apparatus for in-situ kinematic calibration of a serial manipulator arm using constrained configuration sampling
patents.abstract: A calibration method for serial robot arms in which a constrained configuration sampling strategy selects measurement poses that remain within a user-defined collision-free region, such as an orchard row corridor, while maximising the observability index of the identification Jacobian. The apparatus comprises a lightweight reflective target mountable on the tool flange and a handheld total station for pose measurement. An embedded optimisation routine selects the next measurement configuration interactively. The method reduces required measurement time by approximately 40% compared to exhaustive grid sampling while achieving equivalent parameter identification accuracy.

patents.title: Electrode assembly for continuous ohmic heating of viscous plant-based food dispersions with reduced fouling
patents.abstract: An electrode assembly for use in a tubular continuous ohmic heater designed specifically for viscous plant-based food dispersions with dry matter content between 10% and 35%. The assembly features a segmented graphite-polymer composite electrode surface with a helical flow-directing insert that reduces product residence time variance and minimises electrode fouling by starch and protein deposits. Internal geometry parameters and electrode gap dimensions are specified to maintain field strength uniformity within ±5% across the flow cross-section at product conductivities typical of legume and vegetable purées (0.3–1.4 S/m). Filing covers Serbia and selected EU member states under the regional patent cooperation route.

patents.title: Encapsulation device for attaching fibre Bragg grating sensors to metallic pipeline surfaces
patents.abstract: The invention relates to a mechanical encapsulation housing for mounting a fibre Bragg grating sensor onto the outer surface of a metallic pipe. The housing comprises a stainless steel split-tube body, an epoxy-fill port, and a swaged end cap with a strain-relief sleeve for the pigtail fibre. The device is designed to transfer axial and hoop strains from the pipe wall to the FBG element with a transfer efficiency above 0.95 while providing protection against soil abrasion, moisture ingress, and cathodic protection currents. The housing can be installed on pipes in the diameter range DN100 to DN600 without interrupting pipeline service.
